seoDescription: Learn how to securely accept credit card payments on your WooCommerce store by integrating the Stripe payment gateway. This tutorial provides a step-by-step guide to connecting Stripe to your WordPress website. You'll see how to install the free WooCommerce Stripe plugin, create your Stripe account, and configure the settings. We walk through setting up both test mode to safely verify your connection and live mode to start processing real customer transactions, including generating and adding API keys and webhooks.

chapters.description: An overview of the free Stripe plugin for WooCommerce, its benefits, and what will be covered in the tutorial.

chapters.description: This chapter guides you through installing and activating the official WooCommerce Stripe Payment Gateway plugin from the WordPress dashboard.

chapters.description: Learn how to sign up for a free Stripe account and get a brief tour of the Stripe dashboard and its features.

chapters.title: Connecting WooCommerce to Stripe in Test Mode
chapters.description: This chapter explains how to connect your WooCommerce store to Stripe in test mode for safe initial setup.

chapters.title: Configuring API Keys & Webhooks for Test Mode
chapters.description: Follow a detailed walkthrough of enabling test mode and setting up the necessary API keys and webhook endpoint for a secure connection.

chapters.title: Finalizing Settings & Placing a Test Order
chapters.description: Review key payment settings like saved cards and statement descriptors before placing a test transaction to confirm the setup works.

chapters.title: Switching to Live Mode to Accept Real Payments
chapters.description: Learn the process of disabling test mode and configuring your store with live API keys and a live webhook to start accepting actual credit card payments.

chapters.title: Placing a Live Order & Final Wrap-Up
chapters.description: This chapter demonstrates placing a real transaction with a live credit card to confirm the integration is working, followed by a summary of the video.

summary:
## Getting Started with Stripe and WooCommerce

To begin accepting credit card payments, you need to connect your WooCommerce store to Stripe.

1.  **Install the Plugin**: In your WordPress dashboard, search for and install the **"WooCommerce Stripe Payment Gateway"** plugin by WooCommerce. Activate it.
2.  **Enable the Gateway**: Navigate to `WooCommerce > Settings > Payments` and enable the **Stripe** payment option.
3.  **Create a Stripe Account**: Sign up for a free account at **Stripe.com**. There are no setup or monthly fees, only a per-transaction fee.

## Connecting Stripe in Test Mode

Before accepting real payments, it's crucial to test the connection.

> [!NOTE]
> Make sure you are logged into both your WordPress dashboard and your Stripe account in the same browser for the sync to work easily.

1.  **Enable Test Mode**: In the Stripe plugin settings (`WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Stripe > Manage`), check the box to **"Enable Test Mode"**.
2.  **Get Test API Keys**: Click **"Edit account keys"**. In your Stripe dashboard (in Test Mode), go to `Developers > API keys`. Copy the **Publishable key** and **Secret key** into the corresponding fields in your plugin settings.
3.  **Create a Test Webhook**: 
    *   Copy the **Webhook URL** from your plugin settings.
    *   In your Stripe dashboard, go to `Developers > Webhooks` and click **"Add endpoint"**.
    *   Paste the URL, select `charge > all charge events`, and create the endpoint.
    *   Click to reveal the **Signing secret** and paste it into the **"Webhook secret"** field in your plugin settings.
4.  **Save and Test**: Save your settings and use the **"Test Connection"** button to ensure everything is configured correctly.

> [!TIP]
> When placing a test order, use the card number `4242 4242 4242 4242`, any future expiration date, and any 3-digit CVC.

## Configuring For Live Payments

Once testing is complete, you can switch to live mode to accept real money.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The process for setting up live mode is identical to test mode, but you must use the **Live API keys** and create a separate **Live webhook** in your Stripe dashboard.

1.  **Disable Test Mode**: Uncheck the **"Enable Test Mode"** box in both the Stripe dashboard and the plugin settings.
2.  **Enter Live Keys**: In the plugin settings, click **"Edit account keys"** and switch to the **"Live"** tab.
3.  **Repeat the Process**: Generate, copy, and paste your **Live Publishable key**, **Live Secret key**, and **Live Webhook Signing secret** from your Stripe dashboard into the plugin settings.
4.  **Go Live**: Save the live keys. Your store is now ready to accept real credit card payments.

## Key Plugin Settings

- **Enable payments via saved cards**: Allows returning customers to check out faster by saving their card details securely.
- **Customer bank statement**: Customize the descriptor that appears on customers' bank statements to help them recognize the charge and reduce disputes. You can set a full and a shortened version.
